intended_delta: Wire USB_VBUS_DET from 5V_USB via R78/R79 and R80 bleeder. Prove the tap is not on 5V_SYS or 3V3.
observed_delta: 140 percent island zoom shows a 5V_USB rail above the resistor row, R78 from that rail to the USB_VBUS_DET tap, R79 from the tap to GND, R80 4.7k from 5V_USB to GND, and a horizontal USB_VBUS_DET stub into U20 pin 16. USB pair pins 2-5 and 19-20 remain unwired.

checks.name: R78 from 5V_USB to tap
checks.detail: R78-USB pin 1 sits on the 5V_USB rail at y=640. Pin 2 joins the USB_VBUS_DET tap. Not 5V_SYS.

checks.name: R79 from tap to GND
checks.detail: R79-USB pin 1 is on USB_VBUS_DET. Pin 2 returns to a GND flag. The tap is the divider mid-point, not a second pull-down of 5V_USB.

checks.name: R80 bleeder on 5V_USB
checks.detail: R80-USB 4.7 kΩ has one end on the 5V_USB rail and the other on GND, independent of the VBUS_DET tap.

checks.name: U20 pin 16 on tap not 5V_SYS
checks.detail: U20 pin 16 VBUS_DET has a USB_VBUS_DET label and a wire from the R78/R79 tap at y=770. The net is not 5V_SYS or 3V3. Hub 41c8e652. USB pairs still open.
